desc: Derive/ideate the finite-field cancellation closed form and p=2 special case.
Implement input parsing, zero counting, and p==2 handling.
Implement optimized modular matrix multiplication and binary exponentiation for A^p (N<=100, p<=1e9).
Implement odd-p closed-form corrections: diagonal row/column additions, p==3 off-diagonal additions, global sign (-1)^K.
Validate on all samples and small brute-force cases (N=1, all-zero, p=2, p=3 off-diagonal, odd p with mixed zeros).
Ensure output formatting and performance within limits.
